tool.name: toolkit
tool.description: OpenClaw host-tool manifest for local-first, allowlisted CLI access.

retry_behavior.true_action: retry only the same read operation
retry_behavior.false_action: follow suggestion and stay inside the allowlist

safety_notes: Use an OpenClaw allowlist instead of unrestricted shell execution.
Run mutating tools only in a workspace with explicit human approval.
Keep internal API credentials on the worker side in file-queue mode.
